description: Release baseline. Records which capability partitions and artifact versions make up release 1.0, so that a later release can be compared against a frozen point without rewriting history.
notes: Reset to an empty baseline on 2026-08-31 at the owner's instruction. Every ETA-351 artifact, source file and execution log was deleted so the full workflow could be re-run from stage one as an end-to-end verification of the framework.
This file was reset rather than deleted because no workflow stage regenerates a release baseline.

Release 1.0 currently contains no stories. The RTM_UPDATE stage of the re-run will repopulate the capability partitions and the lookup index; this baseline must be updated by hand once the re-run completes.
A new release creates a new baseline file. Existing baselines are never edited.
